full_judgment: 17. The cattle market in this case covers quite a large area comprising khas lands of the Government, private lands, and a portion of the plaintiffs Plot No. 10716. The plaintiff is not entitled to retain that portion under sub-section 2(a) of section 20 of the state Acquisition and Tenancy Act and that Portion is to be demarcated by local investigation before the suit can be decreed with regard to the rest of the plot.
